generic_lessons: A consumed unit and an actual new city can prove the gameplay effect independently of a deficient mod completion receipt. Preserve both facts and never manufacture an observed log or repeat the action.
Compare candidate pending-kind and operation fields to their actual producer, including types. A prose correction does not repair a contradictory submitted patch.
A city founded successfully can still be a poor autonomous expansion. Check actual loyalty and subsequent ownership instead of granting long-term quality from a creation event.
Do not claim native recommendation internals ignore a factor merely because the mod has no explicit filter. Native scoring can be opaque.
When a bounded diagnostic truncates a real source list, preserve its overflow and rerun only the independent read with a justified higher bound; do not silently relabel the first read complete.
Keep UI and Core method consumers distinct; use an already qualified native consumer rather than guessing which missing method caused a compound expression failure.
Military production is within domestic automation; it is different from military unit commands. Keep observer counts separated.
Repeated completion event deliveries need stable object identity before counting game assets.
A formal exit ACK and window closure do not establish process exit. Report an eventual exact-owned test-process retirement separately from clean shutdown validation.
